html:
Here is a new version of M51 published here in March.

I used the advice of Jerry Lodriguss in A Guide to Astrophotography with Digital SLR Cameras. In addition, the Gradient Xterminator and NeatImage programs were used.

The same images (lights, dark, flat) were used.
